title: Running into Armstrong on the road and drinking gin in the 1930s
summary: After joining Don Albert's band in 1932, Alcorn met Louis in San Antonio and elsewhere; they socialised, and Louis loved his New Orleans friends.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road
